description: This file defines the IMembershipService interface and the IndirectProbeResponse struct within the Orleans.Runtime namespace. It specifies methods for membership change notifications, liveness probing, and indirect node probing, along with the data structure for probe responses.

classes.name: IndirectProbeResponse
classes.description: Represents the result of probing a node via an intermediary, including health score, success status, response time, and failure message.

methods.name: MembershipChangeNotification
methods.description: Notifies about changes in the membership table.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Sends a ping to check liveness of a silo.

methods.name: ProbeIndirectly
methods.description: Probes a target node indirectly through an intermediary.
